# Section 1: Overview

# Purpose
To fulfill the gaps of requirement Division Wise Structure (with 3 GSTN) of FA Home and Apparel Pvt Limited

# Business Requirement
To handling job order from GGN to Rudrapur and then Rudrapur to any other outsource vendor.

# Section 2.

# Assumptions
• This change will not impact existing functionalities.

# Section 3.

# Functional Requirements
In this document we are fulfilling the gaps which we are not mentioned in rudrapur point specs.

## We need to add some columns based on Execution type = “Outsource” in Job Order.

#### Header Section: -
• RCM checkbox: This checkbox will appear based on suppliers marked as 'RCM = Yes'. It becomes enabled in the Supplier Master when both of the required settings are activated: -
(i) Company Setting FA Setting Enable GST as per Indian Statutory.
(ii) FA Master Definition GST Setup GST Event Mapping.
• Payment Term
• Delivery Term
• Line Number: Enable Line Allocation For Process falls under Miscellaneous setting

New Screen: -
• Link Block Booking pop up: - This pop should open based on the outsource execution Type.
Old Screen: -
New UI :-

#### Article Tab Section: -
• ETD
• ETA
• In House Date
• Advance Payment Request Summary
New Screen :- This will be applicable for add process and normal job order case.
Additional Charge Section: - In this system need to sum up the value to Tax Amt as it is working in the Old UI.
• Total Tax Value
New UI :-

## In case of Split function, we need to open the mentioned pop-up to splitting the Job order.
When user wants to split any job order then we should open the below mentioned new UI to split the any Job order. After split the qty system always open the new job order screen.

## We also need to provide the Activity time line where user can check the Activity Log & Change Log.
We need an option of Activity Timeline in job order list context menu on grid level where user can check the activity log of the job order.
Activity Log: - In this we need to cover following things.
Creation
Revision
Status log (Like Confirm, RTF & RTP)
Reopen
Split
Confirm
Cancel
Close
Block/Unblock Invoice
Create DN/CN
Transfer Job Order
Transfer Output
Transfer Input Return
Dispatch Instruction
Vendor to Vendor
Change Log: - In this we need to capture all related changes where user changing or entering any value in transaction.

## Dispatch Instruction – New Screen
To create a dispatch note from the Job Order list, the user needs to click on the 'Dispatch Instruction' action.
After clicking on the action of Dispatch Instruction system will open the new UI of instruction.
There are some tools are in header part on Article detail Tab: This is same like in previous old UI and it should be work like as it is working.
• Confirm
• Auto Fill by stock
• Auto Fill by FPO Allocation
• Auto Fill
• Clear All
• The Article Detail (as shown above) will have the following column grid:
The impact of additional related column will be directly come on the main column.
Example: - Additional Instructed Qty. Instructed Qty.
In case of adhoc request the site column will be editable.
• The Additional Article Detail (as shown below): -
In this we need to show only the column of Additional Required Units.
# This should carry the adhoc indent details as it is done in current screen.
• For the Additional Article Detail Tab there will be following two Grid Columns:
• [Setting: - Admin >> Company Setup >> Production Process Order Settings >> Create separate indent if reason are different of additional required qty ]
• Case 1: Setting is Turned Off
The values in the ‘Additional Requirement unit’ column should be displayed as hyperlinks. When a user clicks on a value, the system should open a pop-up window (as shown in the screenshot) and generate the corresponding additional requirement
• Case 2: Setting is Turned On
The edit option is available in Additional Qty to be Instructed column values.
• If the user clicks on the additional required units – column value, the following screen will be shown:
Tool in header are: -
• Save
• Close
• The attachment number shows the no. of attachments added by the user.
• The attachment option once clicked the user will be shown the following screen:
The delete option will not work for the MRL generated lines.
• For Case 2 Above (Setting is turned ON) , if the user clicks on the “Qty. To Be Instructed”( as shown below) -column value
The following pop up will be shown:
• Only FPO linked stores/sites of same FPPO process factory companies’ site should visible at FPPO “Transfer to other factory” pop-up.
Case :- When system not generating any indent of additional requirement and stock will be used from the stock.
In this we will be treat Addition requirement unit column as a textbox, user will directly enter the qty and generate the requirement.
We also need to handle the case where system will generate the additional requirement without generating the indent. This should work based on this setting “Enable Approval for Additional Quantity Request” is disable.
So, in this we have to add to more column in the Article detail tab i.e. “Additional Req Qty” & “Total Req Qty”.
based on these columns we will handle this case where we can generate the requirement and how’s the GDI, GDN & Return case will reflect in the view. The calculation is given below:

## Handling of ICR Consumption Marking against job order GRN
System should ask user to specify Input Material consumption during Job order GRN Creation. Same as available for PRPO GRN. Existing Setting Name: Specify material consumption details at the time of GRN creation in Process Order Setting.
We also need to handling of Input Consumption Tolerance allowance to user while marking Input Consumption during Job order GRN Creation & Job Order ICR Marking.
Note : This should applicable for only outsourced Job Order only
Allow Input Consumption Marking on PRPO
Setting Path: Admin Company Setup Process Order Settings Specify material consumption details at the time of GRN creation.(working for Job Order as well)
Existing screen: -
New Screen: -
Validations :-
• This pop grid data will be depending on the color-size wise dependency.
• In case on 0 qty in the receiving the system will not consider the value of input.
• Adhoc article consumption should mark automatically.
• By default, the input qty will comes through the Routing of the Job Order.
• This should be open for outsource job order only.
We also need to handle these setting by below given approach.
1. Do not show Input Material Details on PRPO Print Preview
2. Display Input Consumption & Wastage in Process Order View- No need in Job order
Solution: We need to open the Job order print on the click of job order number as it is working right now in the current UI. By default, system will show the output article details in the print. If any case client wants to show the input article detail then we should handle this through BI print only. For this we need to give an option to provide the mapping in layout engine mapping on admin section.

## Request to have view functionality for Job Order routing update post GRN
After GRN is created for Job order qty, user clicks on Update/Change Routing hyperlink, system will open FPPO Routing screen with display function only, instead of showing message “System will not allow to change/update routing because the GRN is already created” as of now.
